title: Add uploaded photos to Catalog style cards (Traditional Wear)

requirements.text: Add the two user-uploaded images (1770713137991.png and 1770713334950.png) as frontend static assets for catalog usage, and create 4:3 cropped/resized versions suitable for the catalog card image area.

quotes: Catlog photo mai ise add karo

acceptanceCriteria: The repo contains the uploaded images under a static assets path (e.g., frontend/public/assets/...) and also contains 4:3 variants (e.g., 1200x900) for consistent catalog display.
The 4:3 variants preserve the subject clearly (no important cropping of the outfit).

requirements.text: Update the Catalog UI so each style card displays an actual image (using the style.image field as the source path/filename) instead of the current placeholder icon and image text; include a graceful fallback (e.g., placeholder) if the image is missing or fails to load.

quotes: Catlog photo mai ise add karo

acceptanceCriteria: Catalog cards show an image in the existing 4:3 media area for styles that have a valid image path.
If an image fails to load, the UI does not break and shows a clean fallback state (no broken-image icon in the final design).

requirements.text: Wire the uploaded photos into the catalog by updating the backend catalog data so the relevant Traditional Wear styles reference the new static image filenames/paths returned via getCatalog() (at minimum ensure “Pathani Kurta” displays one of the uploaded images in the Catalog section).

quotes: Catlog photo mai ise add karo

acceptanceCriteria: Calling getCatalog() returns style.image values that match the newly added static asset filenames/paths for the mapped Traditional Wear styles.
In the Catalog section, “Pathani Kurta” renders with the mapped uploaded photo.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (all logic in backend/main.mo).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Do not serve images via the backend; images must be static frontend assets.
nonGoals: Adding new catalog categories or styles beyond mapping images to existing styles (unless explicitly requested later).
Implementing image upload or an admin panel for managing catalog images.

edits: Crop/resize to 4:3 for catalog card use (1770713137991.png > catalog-pathani-kurta.dim_1200x900.png)
Crop/resize to 4:3 for catalog card use (1770713334950.png > catalog-traditional-2.dim_1200x900.png)
